style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Christmas Satin Bow Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Add a touch of elegant shimmer to your seasonal décor with this 180cm satin bow garland. Designed to bring soft sophistication to your festive styling, this beautiful garland features a series of delicately crafted satin bows in a harmonious blend of metallic tones. At 180cm long, it’s the perfect length for draping across mantels, staircases, shelves or doorways, instantly adding a graceful, celebratory feel to your home. The smooth satin finish catches the light beautifully, creating a subtle festive glow that complements both traditional and contemporary Christmas themes. Lightweight and easy to style, this decorative garland can be layered with greenery, lights or ornaments, or displayed on its own for a refined statement. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Garland Length: L180cm.
